jobs.title: Analytics & Modeling Analyst
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.

If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.

Skills and Competencies

• 0 to 3 years of overall experience in credit risk modeling
• Working knowledge of at least two of the following technologies: VBA, C++, C#, MATLAB, R, or Python
• Experience in structured finance and cash flow modeling is a strong plus
• Working knowledge of Moody's Structured Finance Workstation is strongly preferred
• Strong analytical mindset with a willingness to learn new technologies and a collaborative, detail-oriented work style
• Basic understanding of artificial intelligence concepts, with curiosity and enthusiasm for learning how AI tools can be used to improve processes and drive efficiency. Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.

Education

• Graduate or Post-Graduate degree in Applied Mathematics, Financial Engineering, Econometrics, Statistics, Finance, Physics, or Business preferred
• CFA/FRM certification is a plus

Responsibilities

We are looking for an Analytics & Modeling Analyst to join our Model Verification Team and contribute to the integrity of Moody's financial models and rating methodologies.

• Verify and enhance the financial models underlying Moody's rating methodologies
• Build complex cash flow models using proprietary software for verification purposes
• Implement model testing procedures and develop analytical projects to confirm the ability of financial models to assess credit risk
• Build financial model prototypes and assist with the implementation of new control processes for rating models and scorecards
• Support research and validation projects across the team
• Collaborate with rating analysts, model development teams, and research groups to deliver high-quality analytical outcomes

About The Team

Our Credit Strategy & Standards / Modelling & Quantitative Analytics / Model Verification team is responsible for independently verifying and enhancing the financial models that underpin Moody's rating methodologies. The team designs and executes rigorous model testing procedures and analytical projects that confirm the accuracy and reliability of credit risk models used across global asset classes. By joining our team, you will be part of exciting work at the intersection of quantitative finance, model risk governance, and cutting-edge analytical technology, contributing directly to the integrity of Moody's credit ratings worldwide and supporting the responsible a

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Master Data Management
jobs.description: Data Engineer – Master Data Management Summary of Position: This role is responsible for the Data Engineering of Master Data Management (MDM) data within Alcon's AWS data lake environment. Working closely with business and data governance stakeholders, the Data Engineer will design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that ingest, cleanse, transform, and provision trusted master data — with a primary focus on Customer Master data and Product Information Management (PIM) data domains — in alignment with Alcon's Data and Analytics strategy, standards, and governance practices. Knowledge of Customer Master data and Product Information Management (PIM) data domains is highly preferred. Key Responsibilities : Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, cleanse, transform, and curate Master Data Management (MDM) data — especially Customer Master and Product Information Management (PIM) data — within the AWS data lake. Adopt AWS data lake and related data services to implement end-to-end MDM data solutions across ingestion, integration, curation, and consumption. Deliver business solutions on Alcon's analytics platform through end-to-end implementation that includes data security, governance, cataloging, preparation, automated testing, and data quality metrics. Build data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and Spark SQL, integrating master data from a variety of heterogeneous source systems. Collaborate with data governance teams and information stewards to support data quality, stewardship, matching/survivorship, and lifecycle management for Customer Master and PIM data. Automate, optimize, migrate, and enhance existing MDM data solutions and pipelines. Perform data modeling, data analysis, and provide insights that support trusted customer and product master data for downstream analytics use cases. Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, and effort estimation as part of an agile DevOps team. Analyze and manage master data within Master Data Management (MDM) platforms such as Reltio, including customer, product, supplier, and reference data domains. Configure, maintain, and analyze Product Information Management (PIM) solutions such as Stibo to ensure high-quality product content, digital assets, classifications, attributes, and product lifecycle data. Utilize data cataloging and metadata management tools to document, classify, govern, and improve discoverability of enterprise data assets, business glossaries, lineage, and data quality metrics. Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications: Education: B.Tech / B.E / M.Tech / MCA or bachelor's/master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent applicable experience). 6 to 10 years of experience in Big Data / data lake solutions in an AWS cloud environment. 3+ years of experience writing code in the Spark engine using Python , Scala, or Java. jobs.description:
Who we are  
  About Stripe  
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
  About the Organization   
 Payments is at the core of Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We are expanding our payments footprint in India and we are looking for Backend Engineers to own the technical architecture behind our next generation of payment offerings in India.  
 As part of the India Payments team, you will build on top of Stripe’s robust foundational platforms, driving complex integrations and contributing to the architectural evolution of the critical services that handle money movement every millisecond. You will engineer the entire horizontal payments stack, driving every phase of a transaction's journey: integrating with local payment rails, managing initiation and intelligent routing, ensuring reliable completion and automating reconciliation and payouts.  
 Partnering with cross-functional engineering hubs globally, you will tackle high-stakes technical challenges requiring low-latency execution, strict transactional idempotency, zero-downtime migrations and resilient distributed state management at scale. 
 If you thrive on taking ambiguous product mandates and turning them into fault-tolerant, self-healing distributed systems, you will feel right at home here. 
  What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)  
 
 Architect and operate low-latency, fault-tolerant backend microservices that integrate with Indian payment methods 
 Map complex, India-specific payment flows into Stripe’s global, unified API platforms, ensuring a seamless integration experience for developers worldwide 
 Design highly reliable adapter layers that interact with domestic banking partners and payment networks, building systems that gracefully handle external API latency and asynchronous callbacks 
 Own end-to-end service health, implementing shadow rollouts, distributed tracing, automated failovers and proactive alerting for 99.99% uptime 
 Collaborate with Product, Regulatory/Legal, Risk and Partner Integration teams across global engineering hubs while delivering seamless developer-facing APIs 
 Mentor and empower engineers to contribute independently through ongoing technical guidance and actionable feedback 
 
  Other Responsibilities  
 
 Independently scope, build and ship medium-to-large projects from ambiguous requirements to production 
 Build robust APIs that hide the extreme complexity of Indian payment rails behind simple, elegant developer experiences 
 Partner with product and data teams to proactively identify, size and solve the most impactful problems for our users 
 Engineer highly reliable, scalable infrastructure that consistently meets strict SLAs for all internal and external systems 
 Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term 
 Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes 
 Accelerate team velocity through high-quality code reviews and architectural collaboration

Job Title: Senior Principal Data Engineer

Location: Pune / Chennai (Hybrid)

Client is looking for an experienced Senior Principal Data Engineer to provide technical leadership in designing scalable data platforms and driving complex, cross-team initiatives for their cybersecurity platform. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in data engineering, cloud platforms, data architecture, and modern data technologies, along with the ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead architecture and development of scalable data engineering solutions across multiple domains.
• Drive complex cross-team projects and define technical strategies with engineering leadership.
• Own and enhance critical data platforms, services, and engineering practices.
• Evaluate and implement new technologies to improve data capabilities.
• Build and optimize data pipelines, data warehouses, and real-time processing systems.
• Collaborate with engineering teams and stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.
• Mentor engineers and contribute to coding standards, reviews, technical documentation, and best practices.
• Ensure quality engineering practices through code reviews, CI/CD processes, and production deployments.

Required Skills & Experience
• 6–10 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering within large-scale, high-volume environments.

• Experience with Apache Kafka, event-driven architectures, and real-time analytics pipelines.
• Knowledge of Lakehouse architecture, Apache Iceberg, and modern data platforms.
• Understanding of data security, GDPR, and PCI-DSS compliance requirements.
• Ability to independently architect solutions and drive technical initiatives.

Preferred Experience
• Experience working in cybersecurity, fintech, ad-tech, or other high-volume data environments.
• Experience with subscription analytics, cohort analysis, LTV calculations, churn prediction, or behavioral analytics.
• Experience building executive reporting and complex analytics solutions.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst with 4–5 years of experience and strong expertise in data analysis, data modeling, and data visualization. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, and/or Domo and be comfortable working directly with clients to understand their requirements and deliver effective BI solutions.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of data, be comfortable working with business stakeholders and clients, understand their reporting and analytical requirements, and translate those requirements into effective BI solutions.

Job Mode & Working Hours
• Working Hours: Aligned with U.S. Pacific Time (PT)
• Expected Availability: Candidates should be available to work until 1:00 AM IST to accommodate U.S. Pacific Time business hours.

Role and Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Data Analysis
• Analyze business and operational data to identify trends, patterns, insights, and opportunities.
• Understand business requirements and translate them into meaningful data and reporting solutions.
• Perform exploratory and descriptive data analysis to identify key business drivers and performance indicators.
• Work with large and complex datasets from multiple sources.
• Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability before presenting insights.
• Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
• Develop meaningful KPIs and metrics aligned with client and business requirements.
• Present analytical findings in a clear and business-friendly manner.

Data Modeling & Transformation
• Design and develop effective data models to support reporting and analytics requirements.
• Understand relationships between different datasets, tables, dimensions, and measures.
• Perform data preparation, transformation, cleansing, and integration for BI reporting.
• Work with technical/data teams to understand source systems and data structures.
• Develop calculated measures, KPIs, and business logic required for dashboards and reports.
• Ensure data models are scalable, efficient, and suitable for reporting and visualization.
• Maintain appropriate documentation of data sources, definitions, calculations, and reporting logic.

Dashboard & Data Visualization
• Design and develop interactive, user-friendly, and visually effective dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, and/or Domo.
• Build dashboards that clearly communicate key business insights rather than simply displaying data.
• Select appropriate charts, visualizations, filters, drill-downs, and interactive elements based on the business requirement.
• Develop executive dashboards, operational reports, analytical dashboards, and performance reporting solutions.
• Apply data visualization best practices to improve usability, clarity, and decision-making.
• Optimize dashboard performance and usability.
• Review existing dashboards and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Ensure dashboards are consistent, accurate, intuitive, and aligned with client expectations.

Client & Stakeholder Interaction

In this role, you will own end-to-end analytics solutions - from defining the problem to delivering strategic recommendations that influence long-term decisions. Description

Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.

The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
- Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
- Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
- Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
- Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
- Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
- Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
- Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
- Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
- Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
- Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
- Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

Basic Qualifications

- 1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
- 1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
- Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
- Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Sr. Specialist Data Quality & Insights
jobs.description:
Build our future together

Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for people with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, while redefining our understanding of health.

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Senior Specialist - Data Quality & Insights to join our Data Management team in Hyderabad. In this hands-on role, you will lead the reconciliation, validation, and quality oversight of external vendor data across multiple clinical data types. You will use Python, SQL, ETL tools, and data-quality reporting solutions to identify and resolve discrepancies, improve vendor data quality, strengthen inspection readiness, and support reliable clinical decision-making across the portfolio.

When & where

Hyderabad, India

Discover your role

• Perform end-to-end reconciliation of external vendor data, including Central Lab, Imaging, PK/PD, Cytokines, eCOA, and Biomarker data, against Medidata Rave and the Clinical Data Lake.
• Develop and maintain Python- and SQL-based reconciliation scripts, ETL pipelines, and automated data-quality checks for incoming external vendor datasets.
• Investigate, document, and coordinate the resolution of data discrepancies with Data Acquisition teams, vendors, and cross-functional partners, tracking issues through closure and CAPA processes where applicable.
• Execute study-specific data-quality timelines and checkpoints to ensure external data is validated and reconciled in line with protocol schedules and regulatory expectations.
• Implement and enhance Flask/Python-based reporting solutions used to publish data-quality reports and automated QC outputs for clinical and scientific stakeholders.
• Create and maintain vendor quality metrics and KPIs, including error rates, reconciliation timeliness, and protocol deviation trends, and communicate findings during vendor operational meetings.
• Develop data-quality dashboards and vendor scorecards that support inspection readiness, audit traceability, and continuous improvement.
• Partner with GD-IT and Data Acquisition teams on the ingestion, transformation, staging, and mapping of raw vendor data within the Clinical Data Lake.

This role requires

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
• 4-6 years of hands-on experience in clinical data management, external data reconciliation, or clinical data quality within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
• Deep working knowledge of external clinical data types, such as Central Lab, Imaging, PK/PD, Cytokines, eCOA, and Biomarkers, including flow cytometry, genomic, or proteomic datasets.
• Hands-on expertise in Python and SQL for data analysis, automation, reconciliation scripting, ETL pipelines, and data-quality checks. SAS experience is also relevant.
• Experience working with cloud data-lake platforms such as Dremio, Snowflake, or similar technologies.
• Proficiency with EDC systems, particularly Medidata Rave, and experience reconciling vendor data against clinical systems.

jobs.description:
Location : Pune About Team & About Role:   
   
 As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org. 
 You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains. 
 We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team. 
   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   
  Responsibilities    
 
 Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems. 
 Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions. 
 Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought. 
 Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic. 
 Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly. 
 Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed. 
 Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET. 
 Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.). 
 Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature. 
 Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status. 
 
   Requirements    Must-have  
 
 Strong hands-on programming skills in  Golang . 
 Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols:  OIDC/OAuth 2.0  and  SAML 2.0  — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes. 
 Working knowledge of  Active Directory . 
 Applied cryptography/PKI experience:  X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS . 
 Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work. 
 Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency. 
 Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.

Sarvam's model APIs (ASR, TTS, Vision, LLM, Translate) are how developers and enterprises ship products on our foundation models. The platform handles tens of millions of API calls every day, over HTTP and WebSockets, with metering, billing, prepaid wallets and rate-limiting all part of the same stack.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to own major parts of this platform end to end, working closely with the Staff Engineer who leads its architecture. You will take an area such as speech to text pipeline,or text to speech pipeline, and be accountable for its reliability, performance and end-to-end latencies. This role is for someone who is obsessed with latencies, optimizes services and network paths to shave off milliseconds, ships fast, reasons from first principles, and treats AI as the default way to get engineering work done.


What you will do


Own a platform area end to end

• Obsessed with latencies, dissecting existing services to understand the system, and tuning the right knobs to optimize performance.

• Bring services across without regressions in customer-facing APIs, latency or reliability.


Build real-time and model-serving pipelines

• Build and operate streaming infrastructure: WebSocket connections, long-lived sessions queue-based batch processing, backpressure and low-latency model invocation.

• Engineer audio pipelines: TTS chunking around model context limits, sample-rate conversion and format encoding, and VAD-based silence detection for ASR.

• Hold your services to sub-100ms latency SLOs in a multi-tenant environment, and know where every millisecond goes.


Think in systems and from first principles

• Reasons from constraints: latency budgets per hop, throughput, cost per request, failure modes and tenant isolation.

• Use back-of-the-envelope estimates to decide what to build, what to optimize and what to leave alone.

• Prefer simple designs you can fully explain over clever ones you cannot.

• Build in observability from day one: logging, metrics and tracing that let anyone debug production quickly.

• Partner with the Inference and MLOps teams on making model serving fast, reliable and operable.

• Mentor junior engineers through RFC reviews, code review and pairing.

• Practice design-first, documentation-first engineering: RFCs before code, no tribal knowledge.

 Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance. 
 Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.    About the Team   
 Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0  FGA  solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a    CNCF    incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0  FGA  runs that same engine as a managed service. 
  FGA  DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The  FGA  group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers. 
 Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.

 Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples. 
 Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions  
 Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute.
